components.name: TextDots
components.description: Trailing "..." that counts up. The dots always take their full width, so nothing shifts.

components.name: TextFade
components.description: Fades text in slowly, one word after another. `by="text"` fades the whole string at once instead.

components.name: TextSpeed
components.description: Words that race past one after another, in place, smearing sideways as they move.

props.name: travel
props.description: How far a swapping word travels, in em.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Hold the cycle until the text scrolls into view.

props.name: blurStrength
props.description: How readily speed turns into blur.

props.name: maxBlur
props.description: Upper bound on the blur radius, in pixels.

components.name: TextTypewriter
components.description: Types `text` out. Pass an array to cycle: type, hold, delete, next. A single string types once unless `loop` is set.

examples.title: Text Effect
imports: import { TextDots, TextFade, TextPop, TextReveal, TextSpeed, TextTypewriter, TextWiggle } from "@/components/ui/text-effect"
examples.code:
<>
  <TypeCard label="typewriter">
    <TextTypewriter
      loop
      holdMs={4000}
      text="Typed one letter at a time."
    />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="typewriter cycle">
    <TextTypewriter text={["Hello!", "Hi there", "What's up?"]} />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="wiggle">
    <TextWiggle>Oink! Am I real?</TextWiggle>
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="dots">
    <TextDots>Thinking</TextDots>
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="pop">
    <TextPop>Saved!</TextPop>
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="fade">
    <TextFade>Words drift in, one by one.</TextFade>
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="reveal">
    <TextReveal text="Streamed text is paced to a steady read speed, no matter how it arrives." />
  </TypeCard>
  <TypeCard label="speed words">
    <TextSpeed words={["Faster", "Sharper", "Louder"]} />
  </TypeCard>
</>
